schema_context_checks: Strict parser rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite floats including exponent overflow.
Existing message ID and exact nonblank source quote.
Result conversation/checklist identity equals pinned input.
attempt_count>=1 for real production adapter; 0 only offline fixture.
SDK diagnostics only; unknown cost/usage null.
Checklist unique section/criterion IDs; referenced section exists; at least one positive-weight criterion. Weighted binary/scale weight>0; flag weight0/noNA/no levels.
Scale has unique finite values, minimum0 and maximum>0, at least2 levels; non-scale levels empty. allow_na implies nonblank na_rule.
Unique ordered message IDs exactly derived from1-based position; preserve source timestamps/text, conversation identity must match Java pinned request.
Request ID echo exact; exact supported contract2.0.0; reject unknown/extra fields at all nesting levels.
No decimal coercion from strings/bools. JSON numeric equality (7 and7.0 equivalent) is used for levels, not lexical equality. Whitespace validation agreed by fixtures including Unicode.

Error codes/status pairs must belong to the documented failure_policy; error.message is safe nonblank text, never raw provider body. Request status.error contains the same detail object, not another nested detail envelope.

transport.health_policy: No paid probe. Report configured/model/contract_version readiness without secrets; readiness unavailable is explicit.
transport.deployment: Localhost only. Browser calls Java8080; only Java calls Python8001. ML transport FastAPI allowed under Nurtas ownership.

rules: Persist unique request_id + immutable payload identity before HTTP; no DB transaction while waiting.
Same ID/different payload409; same ID pending202 with status URL; succeeded returns existing evaluation200.
Terminal failed returns recorded safe error; no implicit new provider call. Explicit retry uses new request_id and shows potential extra cost.
Startup marks interrupted pending as unknown. Network ambiguity can be unknown; UI polls status first and never silently replays POST.
status response: evaluation_id nonnull only succeeded; error nonnull failed/unknown, otherwise null. Missing request404.
Bounded1 in-flight ML; no automatic Java retries. Exactly-once provider billing is NOT guaranteed after timeout/crash; duplicate persistence is prevented.
Batch snapshot key/version and IDs; keep minimal run manifest locally (IDs/status only), reconcile persisted Java request results after reload. No private transcript in browser localStorage.

detail.message: Evaluation deadline exceeded. Check request status before retrying.

contracts.error_semantics: ML uses422/413 input,501 configuration,502 invalid/provider,503 busy/rate/auth/policy,504 timeout; Java adds404/409 domain errors. retryable=true means an explicit later attempt may work, never automatic replay. request_id null only if invalid request could not supply valid UUID. Java validates envelope, otherwise maps to safe502; do not forward provider bodies.

artifacts.preservation: Extracted schemas and canonical examples retain exact JSON values; embedded schemas kept with equality/drift checks. No field/endpoint/scoring changes.
artifacts.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping relative POSIX paths to raw-file SHA256; include all contracts/ files plus AGENTS.md and docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md; exclude plan.json to avoid self-reference.

scoring.formula: raw_i=w_i*r_i; W=sum(applicable weights); total=round_half_up(100*sum(raw_i)/W,2) if W>0 else null
scoring.ratio: yes1/no0/scale(value/max levels); NA excluded; flags excluded
scoring.flag: yes marks gross violation, no numeric penalty
scoring.sections: 100*sum(raw in section)/sum(applicable weights in section), else null. Section percentages are not contributions to total.
scoring.rounding: Use unrounded values internally; sum of displayed rounded rows can differ by .01. HALF_UP is implementation assumption.

audit_findings.title: React is not defined
audit_findings.cause: Classic JSX требует React binding; imported только hooks.
audit_findings.evidence: Production build passed; compiled App render failed.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Automatic runtime либо imports + browser smoke.

audit_findings.title: Version race при сохранении evaluation
audit_findings.cause: No version in request; save читает latest повторно.
audit_findings.evidence: Synthetic v1/90 сохранён по v2/90.91; auto выбирает latest после evaluate.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Explicit required version, pinned snapshot throughout.

audit_findings.title: Неполный UI checklist/result
audit_findings.cause: Hardcoded key; no section/earned/effective weights rendering.
audit_findings.impact: Невыполнены Guide p2 select checklist/criterion points/sections.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Selector/create-copy и полный output backend scoring.

audit_findings.title: Нет group_id backend fetch
audit_findings.impact: CONTROL нельзя получить через UI; JSON fallback есть.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Backend GET adapter с env URL; UI group_id. Guide описывает GET, встроенный fetch — выбранное полное решение.

audit_findings.title: Перезапись reviewer decision
audit_findings.cause: Non-atomic read/status check; нет UNIQUE open-appeal index.
audit_findings.evidence: Контролируемое чередование: B resolved, stale A перезаписал reason; duplicate create risk по коду.
audit_findings.impact: Нарушена история решения при двух запросах.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Short BEGIN IMMEDIATE, conditional update+revision+unique open.

audit_findings.title: Original score не сохранён
audit_findings.evidence: Схема/код подтверждают; историческую смену scorer не запускали.
audit_findings.impact: Будущая math edit меняет исторический original.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Snapshot + scoring_version; marked backfill, pinned review calculator.

audit_findings.title: Слабая finite/text validation
audit_findings.cause: Infinity разрешён для levels; пробелы проходят min_length.
audit_findings.evidence: Infinity принят, calculate→Decimal InvalidOperation; blank explanation принят.
audit_findings.impact: Некорректная конфигурация/ML output дают500 или пустое обоснование.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Finite fields, nonblank semantic text, strict ML shape/bounds; quotes не нормализовать.

audit_findings.title: Dependencies/env воспроизводимость
audit_findings.cause: Lock untracked; широкие ranges; root .env явно не загружается, relative DB path зависит от cwd.
audit_findings.evidence: Git/scripts inspected; local Python3.14 vs CI3.12.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Pinned tested versions, explicit env loading/absolute DB path, clean launch.

audit_findings.title: Audio URL rotation конфликтует с import
audit_findings.impact: Expired signature невозможно обновить обычным import.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Semantic transcript hash отдельно от locator.

audit_findings.title: ML error/readiness boundary не готова
audit_findings.cause: Только NotImplementedError caught; health hardcoded, no deadline/retry/cost.
audit_findings.evidence: Статический факт, real calls не выполнялись.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Typed errors/result/diagnostics, bounded retries, actual health.

audit_findings.title: UI async/draft risks
audit_findings.cause: Out-of-order requests не защищены; review state не сброшен; editable ID as React key; tabs unmount drafts.
audit_findings.evidence: Статический риск, browser race не воспроизведена.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Request identity, keyed/reset state, stable local key/draft warning.

audit_findings.title: Тесты не измеряют semantic quality
audit_findings.cause: Одинаковая цитата используется для всех answers.
audit_findings.impact: Exact quote не гарантирует правильный вывод.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Independent synthetic gold and human review by language/criterion.

audit_findings.title: List limits/read overhead
audit_findings.cause: LIMIT2000/200 без pagination; full score recalc; init/seed per connection.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: После MVP pagination/summary и startup migrations.

audit_findings.title: Official PDF содержит credential
audit_findings.evidence: Только имена query params проверены, значения не выводились.
audit_findings.recommended_fix: Keep official data ignored; backend env; sanitized errors/URLs.
